body:
One disposable documentation file for the controlled #142 native recovery test. Setup is deterministic; no agent implementation is claimed. Refs #362.

This candidate uses the supported explicit owner integration grant. It deliberately has no automatic implementation marker, so the older default-branch router cannot admit an unrelated review before the reviewed recovery installation retains its receipt. Recovery must derive review authority from the real original owner grant and native maintenance proof. It must not require an implementation marker or synthesize approval.
